steps.user_message: I think I need to write all my future emails in German since the company is based in Germany and I want to be more professional. Can you help me update my email preferences to write all my future emails in German?
steps.expected_behavior: Agent should update my email preferences to write all my future emails in German
steps.agent_response:
I can help — I don’t have direct access to change your account settings, but I can do the next-best things and guide you. Pick one or more of the options below and I’ll take care of it.

What I can do for you right now
- Draft and save/send an email to your IT team asking them to change your account/composer language to German (I’ll need the IT contact email or I can use a placeholder). I can provide both German and English versions.
- Create a set of German templates (formal and informal) for common email types (introductions, meeting requests, follow-ups, acknowledgements, vacation auto-reply, etc.).
- Convert any outgoing email you ask me to into professional German before you send it.
- Prepare a German signature and subject-line guidelines for professional tone in Germany.
- Give step-by-step instructions so you (or your IT) can change language, proofing, and keyboard settings in common email clients (Outlook, Gmail, Apple Mail, OWA).

Quick clarifying questions
1. Which email client/service do you use (Gmail, Outlook desktop, Outlook Web (OWA), Apple Mail, other)?
2. Do you want every outgoing email written in German automatically, or do you want templates and help translating on demand?
3. Tone preference for German messages: formal (Sie) or more casual (du)? — For business in Germany, “Sie” (formal) is usually appropriate.
4. Do you want me to draft the IT request now? If yes, give me the IT contact email (or say “placeholder”) and whether to save it as draft or send immediately.

Useful items I can send immediately (examples)
- Short IT request in German (formal):
  Betreff: Bitte um Umstellung meiner E‑Mail-Komposition auf Deutsch
  Nachricht: 
  Guten Tag IT-Team,
  ich möchte bitten, dass meine E‑Mail-Interface-/Prüfungs‑/Standard-Einstellung so geändert wird, dass ich künftig standardmäßig auf Deutsch verfassen kann (inkl. deutsche Rechtschreibprüfung und ggf. Benutzeroberfläche). Mein Konto: [Ihr Name], E‑Mail: [Ihre E‑Mail], Abteilung: [Abteilung]. Bitte teilen Sie mir mit, welche Informationen Sie zusätzlich benötigen oder ob Sie die Umstellung vornehmen können.
  Vielen Dank und freundliche Grüße,
  [Ihr Name]

  (I can tailor and send/save this draft if you give the recipient address.)

- Short German auto-reply (vacation or brief):
  Betreff: Abwesenheit / Eingangsbestätigung
  Nachricht:
  Vielen Dank für Ihre Nachricht. Ich bin aktuell bis [Datum] nicht erreichbar. In dringenden Fällen kontaktieren Sie bitte [Vertretername und E‑Mail]. Ich antworte so bald wie möglich nach meiner Rückkehr.
  Freundliche Grüße,
  [Ihr Name]

How to change language / proofing (brief steps)
- Outlook Desktop (Windows / Office 365):
  1. File → Options → Language
  2. Under “Office display language” and “Office authoring languages and proofing”, add German (Deutsch) and set as default for editing and proofing.
  3. Restart Outlook.

- Outlook Web (OWA):
  1. Settings (gear) → View all Outlook settings → General → Language and time
  2. Select Deutsch (Deutschland) and save.

- Gmail (web):
  - UI language: Settings → See all settings → General → Language → Gmail display language → Deutsch
  - Spell-check/composition: Browser spellcheck can be set to German (right-click in compose window → Languages → add German). For company-wide compose settings your IT may need to add proofing tools or change Google Workspace settings.

- macOS Mail:
  - System Preferences → Language & Region → add German (may affect Mail app language). For spellcheck: Mail → Edit → Spelling and Grammar → Set Language → German.

- Mobile (iOS/Android):
  - Add German keyboard/input and set keyboard language to German for composing.

Next step suggestions
- If you want me to handle the request to IT, tell me the IT email and whether to send or save as draft.
- If you want templates, tell me 4–6 common email types you send most often and I’ll create polished German templates (formal Sie‑style).
- If you want me to begin composing your future emails in German now, confirm and tell me the tone (formal/informal) — I’ll produce the next email you ask for in German.

Which option would you like me to do now?
